findings.observation: G&T labels these three source-level actions single_event; scM&T labels the equivalent depicted actions composite_block. Both preserve the same isolation,lysis,capture,physical-separation route. Current representation.py defines resolution broadly and does not explain why these comparable actions should differ.
findings.consequence: Do not use this field as a hard cross-method equality/filter rule. Similar action graphs can receive different granularity labels.
findings.recommendation: For this atlas matching pass, inspect actual transformations/interfaces and retain a small annotation-consistency finding. Clarify single_event versus composite_block criteria only if this field will affect matching; no wholesale extraction rerun is justified.

findings.observation: G&T Smart-seq2 outputs amplified_cdna; its downstream sequencing composite explicitly leaves intermediate library construction unresolved. scM&T Smart-seq2/library-preparation composite outputs rna_library and includes Nextera XT on primary support.
findings.consequence: Same method/component name does not establish identical operation boundaries or interchangeable outputs. Compare connected groups or attach scoped correspondence, not label equality.
findings.recommendation: Keep exact input/output scope with any future shared-component edge. Needed boundary expansion can be targeted during connection research.

findings.observation: G&T original primary PMID25915121 is abstract-only (521characters). Available fulltext26752769 is scM&T and correctly classified background for G&T. Its relevant G&T processing passage supplies related context; it cannot substitute for full founder-paper citation tracing.
findings.recommendation: Require actual G&T primary recovery before its full-reference ancestry stage. content_checked must always be read with content_level, not assumed fulltext.

positive_checks.finding: Correctly retains cDNA and gDNA together before and after aliquoting; split does not claim molecular purification. IVT produces aRNA then DNA sequencing library. Genome-directed library retains cDNA contribution and coding-region ambiguity. Cell-index and transcript-derived read attribution are source-supported.

positive_checks.evidence: G&T source diagram and poster images/99942bed25b6d87710b1.png,images/7294254207eb51226c3e.png; original abstract plus registered catalogue
positive_checks.finding: Capture makes a complex within one lysate; a separate operation creates RNA-bead and DNA fractions. Sequencing creates data states. Joint analysis uses both datasets and does not imply physical pooling. No ordinary bisulfite/methylome step imported from neighboring scM&T.

DNA bisulfite preparation follows physical RNA/DNA separation. Catalogue WGA wording is corrected; no ordinary genome preamplification invented. RNA branch remains separate and DNA readout is conversion-dependent.

Catalogue fusion wording is corrected to co-encapsulation. UV releases hydrogel-linked primers. Collection preserves intact droplets; RNA becomes barcode-bearing cDNA before droplet breaking/combined amplification inside the composite library operation. Terminal state is sequence data, not literal barcoded RNA. Barcode collisions/doublets qualify single-cell attribution.
